name: Pointer Intent
description: Reads the pointer's speed and direction to start hover a moment early, to predict which target it is heading for, and to tell when it is settling on one.

props.name: selector
props.description: Which elements inside the box count as targets. Any CSS selector, such as "a[href]" or "button". Targets are marked with two attributes, so they need no React state: data-aim for hover styles and data-intent for prediction.

props.name: onAim
props.description: Called when an element becomes the aim: the target the pointer is over, or will be over within a few frames. It carries data-aim until onAimEnd, one element at a time. Style data-[aim]: where you would style hover: and the hover state starts before the pointer arrives. It is the earliest signal, so it is also the place to start cheap warm-up such as a prefetch; it will sometimes touch a neighbour the pointer never reaches.

props.name: onAimEnd
props.description: Called when the element stops being the aim.

props.name: onIntent
props.description: Called when the engine expects the pointer to stop on an element. The source is "pointer" when that is judged before the pointer reaches it, "hover" when the pointer is on it and settling, "focus" for keyboard focus and "touch" for a touch. A target judged early gets a second call with "hover" if the pointer then settles on it. The element carries data-intent with the same value until onIntentEnd. It is later and steadier than the aim: wait for "hover" before starting anything that should not flicker, such as playing a preview.

props.name: onIntentEnd
props.description: Called when the element stops being the expected target.

props.name: lead
props.description: How far ahead of the pointer the aim runs, in milliseconds of travel at the present speed. Larger values start hover earlier and touch more targets the pointer never reaches.

props.name: horizon
props.description: How far ahead the destination forecast looks, in milliseconds of travel at the present speed.

props.name: dwell
props.description: How much evidence a target needs before onIntent fires, as the time it takes at full confidence, in milliseconds. It also sets how long the pointer must look like it is stopping before the source becomes "hover". Larger values mean fewer wrong guesses and later intents.

props.name: minSpeed
props.description: Below this speed, in pixels a second, nothing is forecast.

props.name: maxReach
props.description: The furthest the forecast may land from the pointer, in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns prediction off and ends the current intent.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a relative div. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the line and the ring. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the overlay, an svg that fills the PointerIntent box and draws a line from the pointer to its aim, with a ring that tightens on a target. Place it inside PointerIntent.

props.name: root
props.description: Watch only inside this element. Leave it out to watch the whole document.

props.name: options
props.description: The same selector, onAim, onAimEnd, onIntent, onIntentEnd, lead, horizon, dwell, minSpeed, maxReach and disabled as PointerIntent.
